blocks.text: Updated at 10:30 p.m. on October 6, 2026 MANILA, Philippines — A surge in September approvals lifted the Philippine Economic Zone Authority’s (Peza) investment pipeline to P297.14 billion, already surpassing its full-year 2025 performance and putting both its 2026 target and record within striking distance. Peza’s record for annual investment approvals currently stands at P311 billion, set in 2012.
